escalation_amount.quote: 3.3 Escalation. Commencing on the first anniversary of the Commencement Date and on each anniversary thereafter during the Term, the Monthly Base Rent shall increase by 2.75% per annum.

renewal_count.quote: 11.1 Grant of Option. renewal_notice_days.quote: 11.2 Exercise. Each option shall be exercised, if at all, by written notice delivered to Landlord not less than 120 days prior to the then-current Expiration Date.

security_deposit.quote: 5.1 Deposit. Concurrently with Tenant’s execution of this Lease, Tenant shall deposit with Landlord the sum of $16,240.00 as a security deposit for the faithful performance of Tenant’s obligations hereunder.

uncertain: Extension-period Base Rent (Section 11.3, page 7) is the greater of the final-month Monthly Base Rent and 95% of a fair market rental rate to be determined by the parties; the market rate is not stated, so first-year extension rent cannot be derived from the lease.
Section 11.1 grants 'one (1) option' but refers to 'each' extension period; extracted as a single 3-year option, but a human may wish to confirm the wording.

Permitted use differs slightly between the Basic Lease Information on page 1 ('Outpatient physical therapy and related medical office use') and Section 6.1 on page 5, which adds aquatic therapy; not a financial term but flagged for review.

Section 4.5 (page 4) caps Tenant's share of Controllable Operating Expenses at 5% per calendar year, compounding; the $9.75/RSF figure is only Landlord's current estimate and is subject to annual reconciliation (Section 4.6).
